raw_text: Manipur situation is far worse than what's being reported. I'm a Northeast India researcher and my contacts on both sides are describing a complete ethnic partition of the state. Meiteis are fleeing the hills, Kukis are fleeing the valley. The Imphal-Churachandpur highway is effectively a front line. There are reports of weapons being looted from police armories. The internet shutdown means verified information is extremely difficult to obtain. This has the makings of a prolonged ethnic conflict, not a riot that will blow over in days.
